language_review.evidence: Main-agent full-text (2,471 extracted lines) and 41 rendered PDF pages, including appendices F–I; final case, labels and original illustrations reread.
language_review.reader_reconstruction: Complete current note and all 12 slides read. Traced creator/executor/evaluator with snapshots; real gpt2.c judge and lack of hidden assertions. Checked five-benchmark four-domain 2,207 tasks, 100 SWE + 89 Terminal feedback and 630 held-out tasks, missing one task, four-task mean 67.775 to 67.8, component editability, checkpoint selection, Opus T3 collapse, exclusion sensitivity, 34/64 positive direction versus selected 2/9 winners and repeat noise.

terminology.article_quote: 负责修改 Agent 程序的模型叫 creator
程序冻结后，在里面调用工具、完成下游任务的模型叫 executor
包在 executor 外面的工具接口、模型调用循环、上下文管理和结束逻辑，合起来就是 harness。
每个“creator × benchmark”独立创建三份程序，报告三份成绩的平均，记作 avg@3。
两次正式提交之间最多用两个固定小检查，每次只跑两套题的前五题，论文称为 probe。
